wiki.title: Jim Harrison (Vermont politician)
wiki.extract: Jim Harrison is an American politician from Vermont. He served as a Republican member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Rutland-11 District from 2017 to 2026. Harrison was the president of the Vermont Grocers Association for decades, staying in that job after it merged with the Vermont Retail Association, becoming the president of the lobbying group Vermont Retail and Grocers’ Association before his appointment to public office.
